target.description: the same large private multi-tenant SaaS backend as b01

gold_set.authored: by hand, by reading the code and its history. No TraceLink output was consulted while writing the expectations.

deviations.cause: a bare word in the prose coincided with a pytest fixture function defined in the test suite, and was linked as an anchor the author never asserted
a two-letter-ish generic name, defined in several test modules, was reported as ambiguous rather than filtered as prose. No anchor was asserted, so nothing false was claimed

gold_corrections.why: two names the gold expected to be unique are defined in both the backend and the frontend. The expectations had been written from a Python-only scan while the index covers TypeScript too — the tool was right and the gold was wrong, corrected and marked as corrected in the private gold file.

discipline: the resolver was not changed while this ran

after_f6_fix.note: same harness, resolver gate added between the two runs
